candidate.title: CytoSeq
candidate.scope: The CytoSeq (gene expression cytometry) microwell bead-capture schematic in the middle row of the assigned Illumina image, clarified by the matching CytoSeq catalogue page and Fan et al. primary abstract. The assigned card title and independent row label identify one target. The visible CLaP and Drop-Seq rows, partial PAIR row, and PAIR chemical legend are neighboring poster context, not alternatives or branches of this CytoSeq workflow. Similar methods and kits listed on the catalogue page do not expand this scope. Cell suspension and bead oligo illustrations are inputs/components; the single-cell-to-poly(A)-RNA icon explains the target rather than depicting an extra RNA-isolation operation. This record describes the shown route, not every CytoSeq implementation or an executable protocol.

features: Input cells are in suspension; the adjacent single-cell-to-AA(A)n icon identifies mRNA as the biological target, rather than depicting a separate preparative RNA-isolation step.
